capacity.rule: Per pair, greedy exact match (qwen_pairs.matches) on the held-out items under the capacity prompt, at W0, absolute. The reuse side holds when hits >= ceil(reuse_min * n); the new side holds when hits <= floor(new_max * n); a tie at a bar holds. A pair is fit only if both hold; a pair that misses is dropped and reported, never repaired. A side with n = 0 makes its pair unscored, never fit.
capacity.expected: facts fit (0.97 against 0.015 in this form, experiments/qwen_updates/results/control.json .facts_s0; here under a 3-shot capacity prompt, a different prompt); copy and context reuse sides near 1; cipher and lookup new sides near 0 on held-out keys (a held-out key's table value and a held-out word's cipher are not in the prompt; the cipher's three examples show at most 24 of its 26 letters).
capacity.blind_to: Whether the skill shows under the cue prompt the library trains on (the capacity prompt names the task); the prior under the cue is recorded beside it, not scored.

floors.rule: K0 per position (all positions) at W0 on the 128 maths rows (qwen_d3.maths_rows) on p-9707d6ff must lie in maths_K0 +- maths_tol, absolute; otherwise the job stops before any other rows are read.
floors.expected_built_rows: no prior number; read and filed for run 2

rehearse.rule_control: The zero change through the saved-state path reads |KL(W0 || W0 + 0)| <= kl0_max on the copy side's own rows and exactly W0's held-out hits under the cue; otherwise the job stops before training.
rehearse.rule_15x: Held-out exact match under the cue prompt (256 held-out keys, greedy) of the copy side, seed 0, at the 15x save >= em_15x_min (hits >= 128), absolute. The 15x save is the first read step at or past 15 x the copy rows' floor (the bracket's upper state). If 15x is not reached by the last step, the rule reads the last step's state and says so (rehearse.json .rule.reached_15x false).
rehearse.early_stops: loss not finite at any step; |dW| not exactly 0 after step 1 (it runs at rate 0); KL(W0 || W_t) on the own rows at step 10 above 15 x the floor.
rehearse.expected: W0 held-out exact match under the cue: no prior number (the cue carries no instruction). The 15x save above 0.5 if 1e-5 for 100 steps teaches a skill W0 already has.
